title: When the question starts ruling the mind
issueStatement: The question may be real, but the circling has become its own fire. You are no longer only seeking light; you are starting to live inside hesitation.
centralInsight: Gurbani does not flatter doubt as depth. It cools doubt by giving the mind somewhere to stand: Guru's word within, saintly company around, and trust in the One already caring for you.
practicalReflection: Some questions must be carried patiently. But some forms of doubt are only self-insistence wearing the clothes of seriousness.
actionPrompt: Bring the question into one line, one guide, and one act of obedience before you give it another full day of your mind.
